title: ColoACT: Multi-Cue Action Chunking for Smooth Autonomous Colon Navigation on a Self-Propelled Endoscopic Robot
summary: Autonomous colonoscopic navigation can reduce operator burden and the risk of loop formation or tissue trauma, but remains challenging due to deformable anatomy, weak-texture and specular endoscopic visuals, and contact-rich viscoelastic interactions. Existing methods either rely on geometry-driven pipelines, which are efficient and interpretable yet brittle due to manually engineered features and switching logic, or adopt learning-based policies, whose inferred depth/geometry can become temporally inconsistent or overly smooth under weak texture and specular highlights while simulation-trained variants (e.g., deep reinforcement learning) may further suffer from a sim-to-real gap. We propose ColoACT, an autonomous navigation system that integrates an RGB-D-E based Action Chunking Transformer policy (ColoACT policy) for a compact self-propelled Bevel-Gear-Based Endoscopic Robot (BGER). The ColoACT policy augments RGB with estimated relative depth and a gradient-based pseudo-elevation map to enhance fold-ridge saliency and other high-frequency geometric cues, and enables smooth continuous control of the BGER by predicting overlapping action chunks and fusing them via temporal ensembling. In different \textit{ex-vivo} porcine colons (approximately 60 cm), our system achieves success rates of 85.4\% and 72.5\% in straight and curved segments, respectively, and achieves 70\% success in 90-degree turns and 60\% in double-bend sequences, with feasibility further demonstrated in challenging triple-bend segments. The project page is available at: https://Adamhu1.github.io/ColoACT/.
tldr: ColoACT proposes an RGB-D-E-based Action Chunking Transformer policy with temporal ensembling to enable smooth autonomous colon navigation for a compact self-propelled bevel-gear endoscopic robot, achieving promising success rates in ex-vivo porcine colons.
tldr_zh: ColoACT 结合 RGB-D-E 多模态线索与动作分块 Transformer，并通过时间集成实现平滑控制，使自驱动齿轮内镜机器人在离体猪结肠中完成自主导航，取得较好成功率。
summary_zh: 自主结肠镜导航能够减轻操作者负担，并降低襻形成或组织损伤的风险，但由于解剖结构可变形、内镜图像弱纹理且存在镜面高光，以及富含接触的黏弹性相互作用，该任务仍具挑战性。现有方法要么依赖几何驱动的流程，这类方法高效且可解释，但因人工设计特征和切换逻辑而较为脆弱；要么采用基于学习的策略，其推断出的深度/几何在弱纹理和镜面高光下可能变得时间上不一致或过度平滑，而仿真训练的变体（如深度强化学习）还可能面临仿真到现实的差距。我们提出ColoACT，一种自主导航系统，集成了基于RGB-D-E的动作分块Transformer策略（ColoACT策略），用于驱动紧凑型自走式基于锥齿轮的内镜机器人（BGER）。ColoACT策略将RGB与估计的相对深度和基于梯度的伪高程图相结合，以增强皱襞脊的显著性和其他高频几何线索，并通过预测重叠动作块及时间集成融合的方式，实现对BGER的平滑连续控制。在多个离体猪结肠（约60 cm）中，我们的系统在直段和弯曲段的成功率分别达到85.4%和72.5%，在90度转弯处成功率达70%，在双弯序列中成功率达60%，并在具有挑战性的三弯段进一步验证了可行性。项目页面见：https://Adamhu1.github.io/ColoACT/。

title: Semantic RGB--Depth Based Surgical Skill Assessment in Microscopic Stereo Videos
summary: Objective assessment of microsurgical technical skill is essential for competency-based training and quality assurance, yet existing video-based approaches predominantly rely on RGB images and therefore overlook the 3D spatial relationships that characterize instrument-anatomy interactions. Although stereo operating microscopes provide complementary depth information, conventional stereo matching algorithms can produce sparse and unreliable depth estimates under high-magnification imaging conditions, limiting their use for automated skill assessment. This work presents a semantic RGB-Depth framework for surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. A regression-based depth fusion method combines sparse metric stereo depth with dense monocular depth estimates to generate a dense geometric representation of the surgical scene. This representation is integrated with semantically decomposed RGB streams corresponding to individual surgical instruments and surrounding anatomy. A hierarchical attention architecture jointly encodes these streams to capture discriminative patterns of instrument use and instrument-anatomy interaction across surgeons at different training levels. The framework was evaluated on 33 ex vivo transoral microlaryngeal procedures performed by six surgeons, comprising attending surgeons and surgical residents, using leave-one-surgeon-out cross-validation. The proposed semantic RGB-Depth model achieved an F1 score of 0.938 for skill-level classification, compared with 0.696 for semantic RGB and 0.929 for semantic depth. These results suggest that geometric information can improve automated surgical skill assessment from microscopic stereo videos. The learned spatial, temporal, and semantic attention patterns also support qualitative examination of the scene regions, video segments, and semantic streams emphasized by the model.
tldr: This paper proposes a semantic RGB-Depth framework that fuses sparse stereo depth with dense monocular depth and semantically decomposed RGB streams in a hierarchical attention model to classify microsurgical skill level, achieving an F1 score of 0.938 on 33 microlaryngeal procedures.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种语义RGB-深度框架，将稀疏立体深度与密集单目深度估计融合，并结合语义分解的RGB流与分层注意力机制，用于显微外科手术技能水平分类；在33例喉显微手术中达到F1 0.938。
summary_zh: 摘要：显微外科技术技能的客观评估对于基于能力的培训和质量保证至关重要，然而现有的基于视频的方法主要依赖RGB图像，因此忽视了表征器械与组织交互的三维空间关系。尽管立体手术显微镜提供了互补的深度信息，但传统的立体匹配算法在高倍成像条件下可能产生稀疏且不可靠的深度估计，限制了其在自动化技能评估中的应用。本研究提出了一种用于显微立体视频手术技能评估的语义RGB-深度框架。一种基于回归的深度融合方法将稀疏的度量立体深度与密集的单目深度估计相结合，生成手术场景的密集几何表示。该表示与对应各手术器械及周围组织的语义分解RGB流相集成。一种层级注意力架构联合编码这些流，以捕捉不同培训水平外科医生在器械使用及器械-组织交互中的判别性模式。该框架在由六名外科医生（包括主治医师和住院医师）执行的33例离体经口显微喉手术上进行了评估，并采用留一外科医生交叉验证方法。所提出的语义RGB-深度模型在技能水平分类中取得了0.938的F1分数，而语义RGB和语义深度分别为0.696和0.929。这些结果表明，几何信息可以改善基于显微立体视频的自动化手术技能评估。学习到的空间、时间及语义注意力模式也支持对模型所关注的场景区域、视频片段和语义流进行定性检查。

title: Learning a Resolution-Consistent Jacobian Field for Bio-Inspired Rigid-Soft Finger
summary: Bio-inspired tendon-driven rigid-soft coupled dexterous fingers exhibit strong nonlinearity and configuration-dependent sensitivity, making accurate modeling challenging. In discrete-time control, Jacobian-based kinematic algorithms typically rely on point-wise local linear approximations, which makes their performance sensitive to sensor sampling frequency and controller update frequency. To address this issue, we propose Jacobian Flow Matching (JFM), a structured learning framework based on Conditional Flow Matching (CFM), to learn a resolution-consistent Jacobian field that models actuation-to-motion transitions as a dynamical flow. The proposed framework supports both single-step prediction and continuous rollout via ODE integration, enabling consistent inference across temporal resolutions. Experiments on a tendon-driven rigid-soft finger show that the proposed method suppresses outlier errors and improves single-step prediction accuracy, reducing the global average RMSE by over 53% compared with a baseline discrete Jacobian learning approach. For long-horizon prediction, trajectories recovered via ODE integration achieve higher fidelity under sparse sampling (Stride = 8), reducing the RMSE median by 14.43% and the error variance by 24.87%. These results demonstrate that the learned flow-based Jacobian field provides an effective local model for offline multi-step trajectory optimization in rigid-soft coupled nonlinear systems.
tldr: This paper proposes Jacobian Flow Matching (JFM), a Conditional Flow Matching-based framework that learns a resolution-consistent Jacobian field for tendon-driven rigid-soft fingers, enabling more accurate single-step and ODE-integrated trajectory predictions than baseline discrete Jacobian learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出基于条件流匹配的雅可比流匹配（JFM）框架，用于学习肌腱驱动刚柔耦合手指的、分辨率一致的雅可比场，相比离散雅可比学习方法显著提升单步预测与轨迹推演精度。
summary_zh: 摘要：受生物启发的肌腱驱动刚柔耦合灵巧手指表现出强非线性和构型相关的敏感性，使得精确建模具有挑战性。在离散时间控制中，基于雅可比矩阵的运动学算法通常依赖逐点局部线性近似，因此其性能对传感器采样频率和控制器更新频率敏感。为解决这一问题，我们提出了雅可比流匹配（JFM），一种基于条件流匹配（CFM）的结构化学习框架，用于学习分辨率一致的雅可比场，将驱动到运动的转变建模为动态流。所提出的框架支持通过ODE积分进行单步预测和连续 rollout，从而实现跨时间分辨率的一致推理。在肌腱驱动刚柔手指上的实验表明，所提方法抑制了离群误差并提高了单步预测精度，与基线离散雅可比学习方法相比，全局平均RMSE降低了53%以上。对于长时程预测，通过ODE积分恢复的轨迹在稀疏采样（Stride = 8）下实现了更高的保真度，RMSE中位数降低了14.43%，误差方差降低了24.87%。这些结果表明，所学习的基于流的雅可比场为刚柔耦合非线性系统中的离线多步轨迹优化提供了一种有效的局部模型。

title: OpenMTB-Audit: Exposing Over-Refusal and Clinical Expert Perspectives in LLM-Based Molecular Tumor Board Safety Evaluation
summary: Molecular tumor boards integrate genomic findings, clinical context, and therapeutic evidence to support precision oncology. As AI enters this workflow, a key safety challenge is distinguishing truly unsupported recommendations from evidence-supported options that still require oncologist review because of incomplete information, poor ECOG performance status, or other clinical caveats. We introduce OpenMTB-Audit, an open-source benchmark of 500 synthetic non-small cell lung cancer cases spanning five adversarial error categories and four safety labels: Supported, Partially Supported, Unsupported, and Insufficient Information. Across eight large language model configurations, we identify pervasive over-refusal: all LLM configurations failed to retain the Partially Supported label in 83.3-100% of true Partially Supported cases, achieving high aggregate safety scores through label collapse rather than clinically calibrated reasoning. To address this limitation, we developed MTB-AuditAgent, a deterministic seven-module framework separating evidence verification, missing-information detection, safety classification, and abstention. It reduces over-refusal to 6.7% and achieves 91.2% accuracy (95% CI: 88.6-93.6%). A two-oncologist annotation study found disagreement concentrated at the boundary between information sufficiency and treatment optimization, underscoring the need to preserve clinically meaningful distinctions.
tldr: The paper introduces OpenMTB-Audit, a benchmark of 500 synthetic NSCLC cases for evaluating LLM-based molecular tumor board safety, and finds that current LLMs frequently over-refuse Partially Supported recommendations. A proposed deterministic agent framework, MTB-AuditAgent, reduces over-refusal and improves accuracy, while expert annotation highlights the difficulty of preserving clinically meaningful safety distinctions.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了OpenMTB-Audit，一个包含500例合成非小细胞肺癌病例的基准，用于评估基于LLM的分子肿瘤委员会安全性，并发现当前LLM经常过度拒绝“部分支持”的推荐。提出的确定性智能体框架MTB-AuditAgent降低了过度拒绝率并提高了准确率，同时专家标注显示在信息充分性与治疗优化之间保持临床有意义区别的困难。
summary_zh: 分子肿瘤委员会整合基因组发现、临床背景和治疗证据以支持精准肿瘤学。随着人工智能进入这一工作流程，一个关键的安全挑战是区分真正缺乏证据支持的建议与虽有证据支持但仍需肿瘤科医生审查的建议，后者可能因信息不完整、ECOG体能状态较差或其他临床注意事项而需要复核。我们推出了OpenMTB-Audit，一个包含500个合成非小细胞肺癌病例的开源基准，涵盖五类对抗性错误类别和四个安全标签：支持、部分支持、不支持以及信息不足。在八种大型语言模型配置中，我们发现了普遍存在的过度拒绝现象：所有LLM配置在83.3%至100%的真实“部分支持”病例中未能保留“部分支持”标签，通过标签坍缩而非临床校准推理获得了较高的总体安全分数。为解决这一局限，我们开发了MTB-AuditAgent，一个确定性的七模块框架，将证据验证、缺失信息检测、安全分类和弃权分离。它将过度拒绝率降至6.7%，并达到91.2%的准确率（95%置信区间：88.6%-93.6%）。一项由两名肿瘤科医生参与的标注研究发现，分歧集中在信息充分性与治疗优化之间的边界，强调了保留临床上有意义区分的必要性。

title: SCOPE-AD: Sequential cost-aware ordinal-belief planning with energy-based models for diagnostic agents
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis requires sequential evidence acquisition under heterogeneous test costs and patient burden. Fixed-modality predictors do not jointly decide which test to acquire or when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. We propose SCOPE-AD (Sequential Cost-Aware Ordinal-Belief Planning with Energy-Based Models for Diagnostic Agents) for cost-aware classification of cognitively normal (CN), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD cases. A mask-aware ordinal model represents uncertainty along the ordered CN--MCI--AD continuum. Retrospective training records provide sampled Bellman targets for an energy-based teacher, whose action distributions are distilled into a Qwen policy. At deployment, the agent selects acquisition or diagnosis actions under availability and budget constraints without access to unacquired values. After each acquisition, the evidence and ordinal belief are updated before the next decision. On ADNI, SCOPE-AD achieves 77.70\% Macro-F1 at an average acquisition cost of \$50.46, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.34 percentage points. Full-modality evaluation raises Macro-F1 by only 1.89 points while increasing acquisition cost by 116.7 times. These results support selective acquisition for cost-effective diagnosis.
tldr: Proposes a cost-aware sequential diagnostic agent for Alzheimer's disease that selectively acquires tests, models uncertainty along the CN-MCI-AD ordinal continuum, trains an energy-based teacher with sampled Bellman targets, and distills it into a Qwen policy. On ADNI, it achieves better Macro-F1 at dramatically lower acquisition cost than full-modality baselines.
tldr_zh: 提出一种用于阿尔茨海默病诊断的序列化成本感知智能体，通过序数认知状态建模、能量基教师网络与策略蒸馏，在ADNI上以极低的平均检查成本取得较高Macro-F1。
summary_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）诊断需要在异质性测试成本与患者负担下进行序贯证据采集。固定模态的预测器无法联合决定应采集哪项测试，或现有证据何时足以做出诊断。我们提出SCOPE-AD（基于能量模型的序贯成本感知有序信念规划诊断智能体），用于对认知正常（CN）、轻度认知障碍（MCI）和AD病例进行成本感知分类。一种掩码感知的有序模型沿CN—MCI—AD有序连续谱表示不确定性。回顾性训练记录为能量型教师模型提供采样贝尔曼目标，其动作分布被蒸馏至Qwen策略中。部署时，智能体在可用性与预算约束下选择采集或诊断动作，且无法访问未采集的值。每次采集后，先更新证据与有序信念，再进行下一步决策。在ADNI上，SCOPE-AD以平均采集成本50.46美元达到77.70%的Macro-F1，超过最强评估基线9.34个百分点。全模态评估仅将Macro-F1提升1.89个百分点，却使采集成本增加116.7倍。这些结果支持选择性采集以实现成本效益诊断。

title: EndoLive: Real-Time Style Transfer for Endoscopic Endonasal Skull Base Surgical Video
summary: Complex surgical procedures around critical anatomy, such as the endoscopic endonasal skull base surgery, requires significant practice and training on the part of the surgeon before they are allowed to perform the operation on a live patient. This training in typically done in cadaveric specimens, due to them containing the same critical structures as a living human. However, cadavers are not a perfect 1-to-1 substitute for a living patient. The dead and preserved tissues of a cadaver are colored completely differently than a living human, and -- without complex and expensive pumping systems -- do not bleed in the same way. As a result, identifying the critical pieces of anatomy that make this procedure so complex can be quite different in a live case than in a surgeon's cadaveric practice. This paper presents EndoLive, a framework for real-time style transfer between cadaveric endoscopic video and living human endoscopic video. Our method combines the ConStructS GAN model for realistic style transfer for surgical applications, with the HyPER-GAN model that can learn complex translations and perform them in real-time. We train EndoLive on unpaired cadaveric and live images taken from an endoscope, and test the trained model with cadaveric video, on a variety of devices. Experimental results demonstrate that EndoLive can perform cadaveric-to-live translation at speeds well above the minimum necessary for real-time, while maintaining semantic consistency of critical anatomical structures. Our source code is available at https://github.com/griffhurt/endolive.
tldr: EndoLive is a real-time style transfer framework that converts cadaveric endoscopic video to look like live patient video for skull base surgery training, combining ConStructS and HyPER-GAN to achieve fast, semantically consistent translations.
tldr_zh: EndoLive 是一个实时风格迁移框架，可将尸体内窥镜视频转换为类似活体患者的内窥镜视频，用于颅底手术训练；它结合了 ConStructS 和 HyPER-GAN，实现了快速且保持关键解剖结构语义一致的转换。
summary_zh:
摘要：

在关键解剖结构附近的复杂外科手术，如内镜经鼻颅底手术，要求外科医生在获准对活体患者进行手术之前进行大量的练习和培训。这种培训通常在尸体标本上进行，因为尸体标本包含与活体人类相同的关键结构。然而，尸体并不能完美地一比一替代活体患者。尸体的死亡且经保存处理的组织与活体人类的颜色完全不同，并且——在没有复杂且昂贵的灌注系统的情况下——其出血方式也不相同。因此，在活体手术中识别使该手术如此复杂的关键解剖结构，与外科医生在尸体上的练习相比可能存在很大差异。本文提出了EndoLive，一个用于尸体内镜视频和活体人类内镜视频之间实时风格迁移的框架。我们的方法将用于手术应用中逼真风格迁移的ConStructS GAN模型与能够学习复杂转换并实时执行的HyPER-GAN模型相结合。我们使用内窥镜拍摄的未配对尸体图像和活体图像训练EndoLive，并在多种设备上使用尸体视频对训练后的模型进行测试。实验结果表明，EndoLive能够以远高于实时所需最低速度的速度执行尸体到活体的转换，同时保持关键解剖结构的语义一致性。我们的源代码可在 https://github.com/griffhurt/endolive 获取。

title: Uncertainty-Guided Handshake: Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Refinement for Surgical-Grade Glioma Segmentation
summary: While state-of-the-art automated models for medical image segmentation achieve high mean performance, they frequently suffer from localized, catastrophic failures that preclude safe clinical deployment, particularly in neuro-oncology. Interactive segmentation frameworks mitigate this by incorporating human oversight, but traditionally impose prohibitive cognitive and temporal workloads by requiring clinicians to manually search for errors. In this project, we present an efficient, Hybrid Structural-Aleatoric Human-in-the-Loop framework for glioma segmentation that bridges the gap between automated baseline performance and surgical-grade precision, achieving sub-2.0 mm HD95 on curated benchmarks while providing safety-net routing for structural failures across real-world clinical data. By extracting voxel-wise Test-Time Augmentation (TTA) uncertainty and applying hierarchical topological filtering, our method proactively isolates high-risk structural anomalies. We comprehensively evaluated our approach on a challenging out-of-distribution clinical stress-test cohort (N = 362). Operating under a simulated Human Oracle, the framework improved the Whole Tumor (WT) Dice score from 0.891 to 0.914 and reduced the 95th percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95) from 5.82 mm to 4.76 mm. Critically for surgical safety, the system rescued severe boundary failures in the Tumor Core, reducing mean HD95 from 17.96 mm to 14.83 mm (improving absolute TC Dice to 0.356). These spatial rescues were achieved while demanding a median interactive workload of just 11.3% of the target volume. Acknowledging this as a simulated upper bound lacking real-world cognitive friction, the framework nevertheless demonstrates a highly Pareto-efficient pathway for safely deploying clinical AI.
tldr: Proposes a human-in-the-loop glioma segmentation framework that uses voxel-wise test-time augmentation uncertainty and hierarchical topological filtering to identify high-risk structural errors, enabling efficient clinician refinement and improved surgical-grade boundary metrics under limited interactive workload.
tldr_zh: 提出一种人机协同胶质瘤分割框架，利用测试时增强不确定性与层级拓扑过滤定位高风险结构异常，在较低交互成本下提升手术级分割边界质量。
summary_zh: 虽然最先进的医学图像分割自动化模型在平均性能上表现出色，但它们经常出现局部性、灾难性失败，阻碍了安全临床应用，尤其是在神经肿瘤学领域。交互式分割框架通过引入人工监督缓解了这一问题，但传统上要求临床医生手动搜索错误，从而带来过高的认知和时间负担。在本项目中，我们提出了一种高效的混合结构-偶然不确定性人机交互框架，用于胶质瘤分割，弥合了自动化基线性能与手术级精度之间的差距，在精选基准上实现了低于2.0 mm的HD95，同时为真实世界临床数据中的结构性失败提供了安全网路由。通过提取体素级测试时增强（TTA）不确定性并应用分层拓扑过滤，我们的方法主动隔离高风险结构异常。我们在一个具有挑战性的分布外临床压力测试队列（N = 362）上全面评估了我们的方法。在模拟人类神谕（Human Oracle）模式下，该框架将全肿瘤（WT）Dice分数从0.891提升至0.914，并将95百分位豪斯多夫距离（HD95）从5.82 mm降低至4.76 mm。对手术安全至关重要的一点是，该系统挽救了肿瘤核心区域的严重边界失败，将平均HD95从17.96 mm降至14.83 mm（将绝对TC Dice提升至0.356）。这些空间挽救是在仅需目标体积11.3%的中位交互工作量的前提下实现的。尽管我们承认这是缺乏真实世界认知摩擦的模拟上限，但该框架仍然展示了一条高度帕累托高效的安全部署临床AI路径。

title: ASCRIBE: Atomic and Significance-Based Reasoning for Thai Clinical SOAP Note Generation
summary: Automatic SOAP note generation can ease the documentation burden on physicians, but existing reasoning methods often omit clinically important information and generate unsupported content. Progress in Thai is further hindered by the lack of publicly available datasets. We propose ASCRIBE, a physician-inspired reasoning framework that ascribes a clinical-significance level to each extracted atomic fact in the conversation before summarization, making a general-purpose LLM a more reliable scribe. We also release ThaiClinicBench, the first de-identified Thai clinical summarization benchmark of real encounters, together with a synthetic training corpus derived from real clinical notes. As a prompt, ASCRIBE outperforms chain-of-thought prompting on GPT-5.4 and Gemini 3.1 Pro across the physician-aligned LLM-judge metrics and improves on standard prompting by up to 10.3 points on the completeness LLM-judge metric. As a GRPO reward, it enables a Gemma-4-E4B model trained solely on synthetic data to match Gemini 3.1 Pro in factual precision and surpass it in completeness. Code and data can be found at https://github.com/loolootech/ascribe.
tldr: Proposes ASCRIBE, a physician-inspired reasoning framework that assigns clinical significance to extracted atomic facts for Thai SOAP note generation, and releases ThaiClinicBench, the first de-identified Thai clinical summarization benchmark and synthetic training corpus. It improves LLM-based SOAP generation both as a prompting strategy and as a GRPO reward.
tldr_zh: 提出ASCRIBE框架，为提取的原子事实分配临床重要性以生成泰语SOAP病历，并发布首个去标识化的泰语临床摘要基准ThaiClinicBench及合成训练语料。作为提示策略和GRPO奖励均能提升大模型生成质量。
summary_zh:
摘要：
自动生成SOAP病历可以减轻医生的文书负担，但现有的推理方法常常遗漏临床重要信息，并生成无依据的内容。由于缺乏公开可用的数据集，泰语方面的进展进一步受阻。我们提出ASCRIBE，一个受医生启发的推理框架，它在摘要前为对话中提取的每个原子事实赋予临床重要性等级，从而使通用大语言模型成为更可靠的记录员。我们还发布了ThaiClinicBench，这是首个基于真实诊疗记录的去标识化泰语临床摘要基准，同时提供了一个源自真实临床笔记的合成训练语料。作为提示，ASCRIBE在医生对齐的LLM评判指标上优于GPT-5.4和Gemini 3.1 Pro上的思维链提示，并在完整性LLM评判指标上比标准提示最多高出10.3分。作为GRPO奖励，它使仅使用合成数据训练的Gemma-4-E4B模型在事实精确度上达到Gemini 3.1 Pro的水平，并在完整性上超越后者。代码和数据请参阅https://github.com/loolootech/ascribe。

title: Ex vivo breach detection using electrical conductivity during robotic pedicle drilling in the spine
summary:
Purpose: Pedicle screw placement is technically demanding in scoliosis treatment. High precision is required due to limited visibility, anatomical variability, and the risk of complications. Although robotic systems assist CT-based planning and execution, they still rely on ionizing intraoperative imaging and complex registration. This study proposes robotic pedicle drilling with real-time preventive breach detection using electrical bioimpedance sensing.
  Methods: We developed a robotic approach combined with a pedicle-drilling tool equipped with a proprioceptive electrical bioimpedance sensor developed by SpineGuard. A real-time detection algorithm was designed to analyze the electrical bioimpedance signal during drilling and identify abrupt changes in conductivity associated with potential breaches towards the spinal canal. The method operates without external devices or sensors.
  Results: The ex vivo experiments showed that the proposed method prevented breaches in 100 of the 51 drilling cases. These findings demonstrate the system's ability to detect potentially hazardous events during drilling and to stop the procedure before. The ex vivo experiments demonstrated that the proposed method prevented breaches in all 51 drilling cases.
  Conclusions: This work demonstrates the feasibility of robotic pedicle drilling with electrical bioimpedance sensing for real-time breach prevention. Using only the tool signal, the method eliminates the need for external sensing systems and supports safer pedicle screw placement.
tldr: This paper proposes robotic pedicle drilling with real-time electrical bioimpedance sensing to detect and prevent breaches toward the spinal canal. Ex vivo experiments report that the method prevented breaches in all 51 drilling cases without external sensing devices.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种结合电阻抗传感的机器人椎弓根钻孔方法，可在钻孔过程中实时检测并防止突破椎弓根壁。离体实验报告称，该方法在全部51例钻孔中均成功避免了突破，且无需外部传感设备。
summary_zh:
摘要：目的：在脊柱侧凸治疗中，椎弓根螺钉置入技术要求高。由于视野受限、解剖变异及并发症风险，需要高精度操作。尽管机器人系统辅助基于CT的规划与执行，但仍依赖电离辐射的术中成像和复杂的配准过程。本研究提出一种结合电阻抗感知的机器人椎弓根钻孔方法，用于实时预防性穿破检测。  
方法：我们开发了一种机器人方法，并配以由SpineGuard公司设计的、带有本体电阻抗传感器的椎弓根钻孔工具。设计了一种实时检测算法，用于在钻孔过程中分析电阻抗信号，并识别与可能穿破至椎管相关的电导率突变。该方法无需外部设备或传感器。  
结果：离体实验表明，所提方法在所有51例钻孔中均有效防止了穿破。这些发现证明了该系统能够在钻孔过程中检测潜在危险事件，并在其发生前停止操作。离体实验证明，所提方法在全部51例钻孔中均防止了穿破。  
结论：本研究证明了利用电阻抗感知进行机器人椎弓根钻孔以实现实时穿破预防的可行性。该方法仅使用工具信号，无需外部传感系统，有助于提高椎弓根螺钉置入的安全性。

title: Evaluating Biomedical Reranking for LLM-Based Question Answering over Longitudinal Clinical Notes
summary: Patient-specific clinical question answering requires locating the right evidence within long, heterogeneous longitudinal clinical records in which relevant facts may be scattered across encounters, repeated in copied-forward notes, or expressed using different clinical terminology. We evaluated whether biomedical reranking can improve evidence selection and downstream answer quality in a locally deployed retrieval-augmented generation pipeline for longitudinal clinical notes. The pipeline combines PubMedBERT dense retrieval, BM25 lexical retrieval, weighted reciprocal-rank fusion, and MedCPT cross-encoder reranking. Across 1,000 open- and closed-ended question-answer pairs from a cohort of 200 bariatric surgery patients, reranking increased exact source-chunk retrieval within the top 10 items, Hit@10 from 46.6% to 60.6% and mean reciprocal rank from 0.2371 to 0.3252. With Qwen3-8B generation, local judge-assessed answer correctness increased from 44.8% to 48.6%. These results show that biomedical reranking can improve the placement of relevant clinical evidence within a limited context window, although gains in retrieval do not translate proportionally into gains in answer correctness.
tldr: This paper evaluates a locally deployed RAG pipeline combining dense retrieval, BM25, fusion, and biomedical cross-encoder reranking for question answering over longitudinal clinical notes, showing improved evidence retrieval (Hit@10 from 46.6% to 60.6%) but only modest gains in downstream answer correctness.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了一种本地部署的RAG流水线，结合稠密检索、BM25、融合和生物医学交叉编码器重排序，用于纵向临床笔记问答；结果显示证据检索显著提升（Hit@10从46.6%升至60.6%），但下游答案正确性提升有限。
summary_zh: 针对特定患者的临床问题回答需要在冗长且结构多样的纵向临床记录中定位正确的证据；相关事实可能分散在不同就诊记录中、重复出现在复制前移的病程记录中，或以不同临床术语表达。我们评估了在本地部署的纵向临床笔记检索增强生成流水线中，生物医学重排序能否改善证据选择和下游答案质量。该流水线结合了 PubMedBERT 稠密检索、BM25 词法检索、加权倒数秩融合以及 MedCPT 交叉编码器重排序。在来自 200 名减重手术患者队列的 1000 个开放式与封闭式问答对上，重排序将前 10 项内的精确源块检索 Hit@10 从 46.6% 提升至 60.6%，平均倒数排名从 0.2371 提升至 0.3252。使用 Qwen3-8B 生成时，本地裁判评估的答案正确率从 44.8% 上升至 48.6%。这些结果表明，生物医学重排序能够改善相关临床证据在有限上下文窗口中的排布，尽管检索性能的提升并未按比例转化为答案正确性的提升。
